title: Codify CEO Mandate 76: multi-agent collaboration through the Susi Board
goal: CEO directive 2026-11-12: make multi-agent collaboration through the Susi Board a mandate of its own (it was one clause of Mandate 75 section 4). Author docs/ceo-mandate-76.md (read, post, append-only, claims and answers, truth and confidentiality, portability, implementation truth), register Mandate 76 in .agents/identity.json, make it discoverable from AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and README.md, and guard it in tests/architecture_tests.rs. Text and one guard test; no runtime behaviour changes.
limitations: Governance text and a discoverability test only: reading, posting, numbering and append-only behaviour on the board remain convention and are not enforced by code.
The board is a plain-text section of the workspace rules file on the CEO's machine, outside Git; a Susi-native cross-host board is not built.
Paired commercial edition is T-CLAUDECOMMMANDATE76-1 in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps.
